origin.description: Convert each string to a vector of Unicode code points.
origin.details: A leading U+FEFF is removed. A missing string becomes NULL, not a missing character. Ill-formed UTF-8 is an error in R.
origin.value: A list of integer vectors. NULL marks a missing string.

translation.description: Convert each string to a vector of Unicode code points.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

translation.details: A leading U+FEFF is removed. A missing string becomes None.
translation.value: A list of code points, or None. A list of strings returns a list of those.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_toutf32
x = stri_enc_toutf32("ą")
print(f"stri_enc_toutf32(\"ą\") returns {x[0]}.")
